data_fields.name: sent-move watchdog before resync
data_fields.donor_constant: 10000 ms, then page reload (rejected as a reload; keep the detection)

best_idea: Buffer one input while the action is not yet allowed; on the tick the window opens, re-check the duel state and legality, then fire it or drop it with a cue.
decision_why: The one-slot buffer with a state re-check on the tick the window opens fits a fast duel; chess legality is not ours, the buffer must be server-checked, and the donor's fail-open legality catch and page-reload watchdog are not kept as written.
acceptance: A src/fight server test: an attack recorded during recovery fires on the first tick the window opens when the target is still in range; it is dropped with a missed-input event if the duel state version changed; a throwing legality check drops it.
